note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; the substituted datum is the status of one event in a supplied model — nothing is run, inferred or decided.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Four-event shop model set up to be run again; the lens enlarges event 2's slot and its status changes from present to removed from the model (the claw lifts it out).

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Six events with near-maximum labels and times, two long loss descriptions, two alternatives, two link captions, long before/after values and long context labels.

events.label: Delivery crate left partly blocking the main customer aisle of the shop overnight
Motorised floor-cleaning trolley makes contact with the delivery crate at the corner
Freestanding shelf unit standing directly behind the crate is jolted sideways
Ceramic display stand next to the shelf unit begins to wobble on its uneven feet
Glass display cover resting on the stand slides slowly towards the front edge
Display cover falls against the tall pedestal holding the hand-painted vase

causalLinks.label: causal as stated in Party A’s written account of events
disputed by Party B in its reply to the written account

alternatives.label: A customer leaning heavily on the display stand shortly before the incident
Vibration from a delivery lorry unloading at the rear door of the shop

losses.label: Hand-painted ceramic vase cracked from rim to base (hypothetical value 1,200 units)
Glazed water jug chipped along its lip and handle (hypothetical value 300 units)

params.beforeValue: Event 4 present in the model exactly as supplied by Party A in its written account
params.afterValue: Event 4 removed from the model for the replay requested in Party B’s written reply
